d:
Aurora Beaumont wasn’t born into silk sheets and champagne mornings.

Once upon a time, she was just a small-town dreamer counting coins and staring at mansion gates… until one reckless night she made a wish under a shooting star: “I want the life that looks good on me.”

The next morning? New last name. New closet. New attitude.

Sweet? Maybe.
Spoiled? Definitely.
Irresistible? Always. 💋✨
